events.title: Sicilian Vespers uprising begins in Palermo
events.description: At the hour of vespers outside the church of Santo Spirito, Sicilians rose against Charles of Anjou's French rule, killing thousands. The island passed to Peter III of Aragon.
events.html: At the hour of vespers outside the church of Santo Spirito, Sicilians rose against Charles of Anjou's French rule, killing thousands. The island passed to Peter III of Aragon.

events.title: Allied armies win the Battle of Paris
events.description: Russian, Prussian and Austrian forces stormed the heights around Paris, and the city capitulated that night. Coalition troops entered the next day, and Napoleon abdicated within a week.
events.html: Russian, Prussian and Austrian forces stormed the heights around Paris, and the city capitulated that night. Coalition troops entered the next day, and Napoleon abdicated within a week.

events.title: Crawford Long uses ether to anaesthetise a patient
events.description: In Jefferson, Georgia, Dr Crawford Long removed a tumour from James Venable's neck after giving him ether. He did not publish until 1849, after William Morton's public demonstration.
events.html: In Jefferson, Georgia, Dr Crawford Long removed a tumour from James Venable's neck after giving him ether. He did not publish until 1849, after William Morton's public demonstration.

events.title: Treaty of Paris ends the Crimean War
events.description: Russia accepted the neutralisation of the Black Sea, barring warships from its waters, and gave up southern Bessarabia. The powers guaranteed the integrity of the Ottoman Empire.
events.html: Russia accepted the neutralisation of the Black Sea, barring warships from its waters, and gave up southern Bessarabia. The powers guaranteed the integrity of the Ottoman Empire.

events.title: United States agrees to buy Alaska from Russia
events.description: William Seward signed a treaty to buy Alaska for 7.2 million dollars, about two cents an acre. Mocked as 'Seward's Folly', it proved rich in gold, fish and oil.

events.title: Ronald Reagan shot outside the Washington Hilton
events.description: John Hinckley Jr. wounded the President and three others, including press secretary James Brady. Reagan, hit in the chest, recovered quickly, and his humour in hospital boosted his popularity.
